description: Revised Batch E proposal. Buddies receives a lean Evidence/assessment clarification. Tilted is corrected from an incomplete Commander-only read to a source-to-Supabase event reconciliation: preserve the existing Friday Commander/FNM series, add the supported weekly Sunday Draft with July 19 and July 26 occurrences, add the July 31 Marvel Super Heroes Commander Party, add the August 7 Hobbit prerelease, attach source-specific provenance, and downgrade research closure to corrected-main-pass-required/discovery until the remaining ordinary social/community sweep is complete. No Grails write, schema/auth/RLS/app-code change, or canonical JSON edit is proposed.

fields.assessment_notes: Buddies Collectibles remains a useful but commerce-heavy Gardena TCG lead. The official site supports current identity, in-store/online operation, Magic product depth, weekly tournament infrastructure, and a strong live-stream/live-commerce posture. The direct Yelp page and Google/Yelp-derived mirrors support a generally positive store-quality read: helpful/friendly staff, strong selection, open tables, and some tournament/community warmth. Whatnot reinforces that Buddies has meaningful live-commerce/community scale, but mostly as a commerce signal rather than proof of in-person Magic play. The Friday casual Commander event remains the actionable MTG calendar lead from Wizards/EventLink; the main remaining planning unknown is lived Commander turnout, proxy/power expectations, and solo-arrival comfort, best resolved by Discord or a targeted community-texture replay.

fields.title: Tilted Magic Draft
fields.details: Store-controlled and Wizards listings support a casual Magic draft every Sunday. Check-in is 2:30 PM for a 3:00 PM start, with 16 seats, packs per win, and a four-player minimum. Players vote before the event between a chaotic draft using one pack from each of three offered sets or a single-set three-pack draft. Seats are first come, first served in store; online interest does not reserve a place.

fields.assessment_notes: Tilted Gaming requires a corrected main pass because earlier work mistook one Commander series for complete Magic-event coverage. The live first-party/Wizards reconciliation now shows a broader and personally useful mix: Friday casual Commander/FNM, a weekly Sunday draft, a July 31 Marvel Super Heroes Commander Party, and an August 7 Hobbit prerelease. At roughly six miles away, that format breadth materially improves its planning value. The official site also confirms current operation, hours, in-store first-come signup, limited seats, and competitive multi-TCG positioning. A direct Discord invite appears under the public calendar beside the phone contact and is captured as an event/community-support route; its content was not inspected and remains a named replay TBD. The embedded Google Calendar rendered empty during this check despite the homepage and Wizards listings, so it is a source-health caution rather than negative event evidence. Keep Tilted in corrected-main-pass-required/discovery status until Instagram/Discord/community texture, proxy norms, Commander power mix, and solo-arrival behavior receive the remaining bounded review.

operations.reason: Correct the event-completeness failure and prevent the venue from remaining marked adequately reviewed before the remaining main-pass surfaces close.

positives: Only about six miles from Los Alamitos, making repeat visits practical.
Current Wizards and store-controlled evidence supports Friday casual Commander/FNM plus a weekly Sunday draft.
Current dated specials include a Marvel Super Heroes Commander Party and a high-priority Hobbit prerelease.
Official sources provide clear hours, address, a direct Discord event-support route, signup rules, capacity, fees, and event structure.
Paid structured events and first-come signup create a defined entry path for unaffiliated players.
cautions: Official positioning is a competitive multi-TCG hub, so casual/proxy comfort should not be assumed.
Seats require in-store signup and may fill; arriving early matters.

The Discord route is captured, but Instagram and Discord content have not been inspected sufficiently for Commander turnout, power mix, pod formation, or solo-arrival culture.
Research closure remains corrected main pass required despite high confidence in operation and event facts.
